title: Enabling keyboard manager overrides the system keyboard setting
author: wilczarzgit
summary: Keyboard Manager can break Polish Programmer-layout AltGr characters and trigger commands instead.

confidence.rationale: The control implicates Keyboard Manager; exact matching behavior needs inspection.

judgment.rationale: The enable/disable control supports preserving unconfigured AltGr composition.
evidence: Disabling Keyboard Manager restores AltGr characters.
Send text becomes unreliable at normal fast typing speeds.

fix_assessment.rationale: No concrete existing fix covers the reported path; the lightweight hypothesis is ready for a bounded design workflow.
